ordinals.finding: Synchronizes architecture/whitepaper/how-it-works/memory/use-case/benchmark documentation and counts with the QR service. Documentation lineage only; does not create a second implementation mechanism.

Integrates a coherence gap into attention and a coarse what-if coherence factor into Genesis manifestation scoring.

ordinals.finding: Translation-only change; commit explicitly states no Python/system files modified.

ordinals.title: Link whitepaper in README navigation bar
Add technical whitepaper: architecture as the breakthrough, not the model
ordinals.finding: Preserves the project's historical scaffold-first framing: persistent state, deterministic orchestration, traceability and constraints are treated as the identity-bearing architecture around a replaceable LLM.
ordinals.epistemic_boundary: Assertions such as complete traceability, invariants being unbypassable, model irrelevance, and all black-box concerns being shifted to the scaffold are source-authored architectural claims here, not independently reproduced measurements.

ordinals.title: docs: update README with agentic tools, 25 skills, use cases, and safety guardrails
ordinals.finding: Documents the then-current agentic tool/skill surface and deletion/sandbox guardrails. The actual deletion enforcement mechanism is separately implemented at k328; this documentation receives no duplicate mechanism credit.

ordinals.title: docs: add USECASES.md — honest capability catalog in 3 tiers + 5 unique use cases
ordinals.finding: Historical capability/use-case catalog with explicit limitations is useful as self-model/product lineage.
ordinals.epistemic_boundary: Claims that capabilities were unique to Frank or absent from cloud AI are historical source assertions and are not promoted to verified novelty claims.

ordinals.title: feat: hard delete guardrail + 5 new OpenClaw skills
ordinals.finding: Removes fs_delete from the registered capability surface and adds executor-side rejection of common destructive Python/bash deletion operations. Also adds five skill definitions.
ordinals.negative_result_value: A safety policy expressed only as approval/risk metadata was considered insufficient for the no-delete invariant, so enforcement moved to capability removal plus executor checks.
ordinals.epistemic_boundary: Regex/pattern blocking demonstrates defense-in-depth intent but is not a proof that every deletion-equivalent path is impossible. A typed capability/effect boundary would be stronger than textual command filtering.

ordinals.title: feat: add doc_read agent tool for PDF/DOCX extraction via ingestd
ordinals.finding: Adds a dedicated read-only doc_read capability routed to ingestd /read_file and explicitly auto-approves it as low-risk. This separates document extraction semantics from generic raw filesystem reads and exemplifies least-privilege effect routing.

ordinals.title: chore: release cleanup — remove dead references, update all docs
ordinals.finding: Removes obsolete voice/wallpaper references, changes gaming checks away from a dead port, updates feature-training ground truth, entity/GWT counts and self-knowledge/docs. Demonstrates that feature removal requires invalidation across runtime code, documentation, self-model and training/ground-truth surfaces rather than code deletion alone.
ordinals.negative_result_value: Stale references and stale ground truth survived previous architectural changes and needed explicit reconciliation.

ordinals.title: fix: remove all X11 probing during gaming (anti-cheat TCC fix)
ordinals.finding: Replaces intrusive X11 window probing during gaming with process-only /proc cmdline detection and pauses the BSN watcher in gaming mode.
ordinals.negative_result_value: Observability itself perturbed the external environment: repeated wmctrl/xprop/xdotool inspection was reported to trigger UT2004 TCC anti-cheat kicks. Monitoring therefore needs mode-aware observer-effect budgets, not just read-only intent.

ordinals.title: fix: notification truncation and anti-cheat game detection
ordinals.finding: Replaces fixed 15/25-word notification truncation with extraction of complete sentences and further reduces game-window probing/poll frequency.
ordinals.negative_result_value: Fixed word-count truncation could cut semantic units mid-sentence; presentation compression is not semantically neutral.

ordinals.title: refactor: simplify BSN to maximize-and-strut approach
ordinals.finding: Removes a complex application-level geometry/boundary enforcement loop and delegates layout to the window manager's native maximize+strut behavior, retaining only lightweight reconciliation. This is a concrete simplification pattern: use substrate-native invariants instead of duplicating them in a parallel controller when equivalent.

ordinals.title: fix: faster overlay restart after gaming mode exit
ordinals.finding: Parallelizes independent systemd service restarts and shortens overlay verification/subprocess timeouts.
ordinals.epistemic_boundary: The commit's timing assumptions (for example overlay normally starting in about two seconds) are historical source-reported operating assumptions, not reproduced benchmarks in this Level-0 pass.

ordinals.title: feat: robust /restart with wave-based parallel restart, live colored status bubble
ordinals.finding: Introduces dependency-ordered restart waves with intra-wave parallelism, durable restart-result state across overlay process replacement, and singleton/dead-man fixes.
ordinals.negative_result_value: Opening a singleton lockfile with truncating mode before flock could destroy the incumbent PID before ownership was acquired, creating a race/split-brain hazard. Recovery logic also risked duplicate overlay spawning without conditional failsafe handling.
ordinals.transfer: Acquire ownership before mutating ownership metadata; model restart as a dependency DAG (ordered layers, parallel independent nodes); persist user-visible operation receipts outside any process that is intentionally restarted.

mechanism_families.name: ENGINEERED_COHERENCE_SIGNAL
mechanism_families.current_research_implication: Treat QUBO/energy-based coherence as an authored consistency feature whose causal utility requires ablation against simpler baselines; do not label low energy as truth or consciousness.

mechanism_families.name: TYPED_CAPABILITY_AND_EFFECT_BOUNDARIES
mechanism_families.current_research_implication: Prefer capability absence/typed effects/least privilege over prompt policy and regex-only denial. Harness should fuzz equivalent destructive paths and verify that read-only effects remain non-mutating.

mechanism_families.name: CROSS_LAYER_SUPERSESSION_INVALIDATION
mechanism_families.current_research_implication: Feature deletion/supersession needs a lineage invalidation graph covering code, service maps, self/world model, docs, training ground truth and tests; stale semantic references are a correctness failure.

mechanism_families.name: OBSERVER_EFFECT_BUDGET
mechanism_families.current_research_implication: A nominally read-only sensor can still perturb protected/interactive environments. Retina/desktop/runtime sensing should expose quiescent modes, sampling budgets and environment-sensitive probe classes.

mechanism_families.name: SUBSTRATE_NATIVE_CONSTRAINT_OWNERSHIP
mechanism_families.current_research_implication: Do not reproduce substrate invariants in a competing application state machine where the OS/runtime can own them reliably; minimize duplicate authorities.

mechanism_families.name: DEPENDENCY_DAG_RECOVERY
mechanism_families.current_research_implication: Recovery should encode dependency ordering explicitly, parallelize only independent units, preserve receipts across process death, and protect singleton ownership with acquire-before-write semantics.

negative_results_preserved: An observability loop can trigger external anti-cheat defenses even when it only reads window/process state.
Fixed word-count truncation can damage semantic units and user-visible meaning.
Stale feature references can survive in self-knowledge, documentation and training ground truth after runtime removal.
Write-before-lock singleton bookkeeping can corrupt ownership metadata and permit duplicate-process behavior.
Dead-man/failsafe restart logic can itself spawn a duplicate overlay if process ownership is not reconciled.
Regex-based effect denial is defense-in-depth, not a formal proof of capability absence.
